mode: Six abstract plants (500,501,519,520,521,522), Louis XVI (212), and Runaway Zombie (213). Replacements occupy vanilla seed slots in adventure and one unified sandbox catalogue, without a New Cards tab or duplicate vanilla entries. Gatling Shooter (522) replaces slot 40, retaining native art, 250-sun price and Repeater upgrade requirement: one 15-damage native pea every 10 ticks, overheat after 120 shots (12 seconds), then exactly 350 cooling ticks (3.5 seconds). A compact heat/cooling bar and native steam indicate state. Per-plant heat, cooling clocks and per-projectile damage tags survive optional saves; native fire conversion does 30 damage. Tucking Sunflower (520) keeps its standing portrait and slot-53 save migration. Long Repeater (521) retains its 50-shot, 1-damage volley and 60-percent pea/shadow size. Other mechanics, native gating and campaign progress are unchanged.
